evals.expected_output: Builds a private curriculum map from the mirror (lesson, unit, week, objectives in its own words, vocabulary), then a committable topic-level backlog in its own words with no source text or brand. evals.prompt: build all six of those explainers at once with subagents

evals.prompt: the explainers look fine on my laptop, we're done
